description: Wave 1a: 12 generic seamless map tiles (neutral dir; real map paths come with our own maps).

slots.summary: a weathered grey cast-concrete wall with faint formwork lines, small air pockets and light water staining spread evenly
an old dull-red brick wall in running bond, slightly irregular bricks with grey mortar joints, about 8 brick courses high across the image
an off-white painted interior plaster wall with subtle trowel texture, faint scuffs and slight greyish grime, very even
a worn medium-brown wooden plank floor, horizontal boards of equal width running straight across, staggered butt joints, soft grain
a floor of square beige-grey ceramic tiles in a regular 4 by 4 grid with thin dark grout lines, slightly worn and dirty
a dull grey painted steel wall plate panel with a raised border seam and small rivets near the panel edges, light scratches and faint rust spots
an industrial steel bar-grating floor: a regular grid of dark grey flat steel bars with square openings, dark shadowed void showing through, worn edges
short natural lawn grass seen from directly above, dense green-olive blades with a few dry yellowish patches spread evenly
packed brown earth ground seen from directly above, with small pebbles, fine soil grain and faint dry cracks spread evenly
a dark grey weathered asphalt road surface seen from directly above, fine aggregate grain with small light stones, no road markings
the face of a wooden shipping crate: horizontal pine planks framed by a plank border around the whole square, with nail heads, no stencils or markings
slots.seam_note: framed design: the border plank repeats as stacked crates; a high seam excess is expected

slots.summary: a commercial office floor carpet in dull blue-grey with a fine woven loop-pile texture and subtle flecks, seen from directly above
